symbols.name: axis length
symbols.meaning: The length of axis i, the number of entries along that axis.
symbols.quote: Let $d$ be the number of axes, with $i$ and $j$ running from $1$ to $d$ as axis indices (not list positions), and let $s_i$ be the length of axis $i$, with $s_1,\ldots,s_d$ pairwise coprime.

symbols.name: earlier axis product
symbols.meaning: The product of the lengths of the axes before axis i, the number of coefficient positions on those axes.

symbols.name: inverse of P_i
symbols.meaning: The inverse of P_i modulo s_i, so that mu_i P_i is congruent to 1 modulo s_i.
symbols.quote: Since $P_i$ is coprime to $s_i$, it has an inverse $\mu_i$ modulo $s_i$, so $\mu_iP_i\equiv1\pmod{s_i}$.

symbols.name: axis variable
symbols.meaning: The formal variable of axis i, whose powers index the entries along that axis.
symbols.quote: Let $x_i$ be the variable of axis $i$, and let $\mathcal R=\mathbb C[x_1,\ldots,x_d]/(x_1^{s_1}-1,\ldots,x_d^{s_d}-1)$ be the target ring.

symbols.name: target ring
symbols.meaning: The quotient ring C[x_1,...,x_d] modulo the relations x_i^{s_i} - 1, the ring that holds the image of the convolution.
symbols.quote: Let $x_i$ be the variable of axis $i$, and let $\mathcal R=\mathbb C[x_1,\ldots,x_d]/(x_1^{s_1}-1,\ldots,x_d^{s_d}-1)$ be the target ring.

symbols.name: axis map
symbols.meaning: The algebra map from C[x]/(x^S-1) to the target ring that sends x to the product of x_i^{mu_i}.
symbols.quote: Let $\Phi$ be the algebra map (respecting sums, products and scalars) with $\Phi(x)=\prod_i x_i^{\mu_i}$ that maps $\mathbb C[x]/(x^S-1)$ into the [Quotient ring by several relations](quotient-ring.md) $\mathcal R$.

symbols.name: coefficient index
symbols.meaning: A position in the list of S coefficients, an integer with 0 <= k < S.
symbols.quote: For a coefficient index $k$ with $0\le k<S$ (the position of a coefficient in the list), $\Phi(x^k)=\prod_i x_i^{\mu_ik}$ is a monomial whose exponent on $x_i$ is $b_i$, where $0\le b_i<s_i$ and $b_i\equiv\mu_ik\pmod{s_i}$.

symbols.name: second coefficient index
symbols.meaning: A second coefficient index, an integer with 0 <= k' < S, compared with k.
symbols.quote: If $k$ and $k'$ (another index with $0\le k'<S$) give the same $b_i$ for every $i$, then each $s_i$ divides $k-k'$.

symbols.name: target exponent
symbols.meaning: The exponent of x_i in the monomial Phi(x^k), reduced to lie in 0 <= b_i < s_i.
symbols.quote: For a coefficient index $k$ with $0\le k<S$ (the position of a coefficient in the list), $\Phi(x^k)=\prod_i x_i^{\mu_ik}$ is a monomial whose exponent on $x_i$ is $b_i$, where $0\le b_i<s_i$ and $b_i\equiv\mu_ik\pmod{s_i}$.

symbols.name: axis digit
symbols.meaning: The digit of k on axis i in its mixed-radix expansion, an integer with 0 <= a_i < s_i.
symbols.quote: Here $a_j$ is the digit of $k$ on axis $j$, and $a_i$ means the same with $i$ in place of $j$.

symbols.name: axis index
symbols.meaning: The index of an axis, running from 1 to d.
symbols.quote: Let $d$ be the number of axes, with $i$ and $j$ running from $1$ to $d$ as axis indices (not list positions), and let $s_i$ be the length of axis $i$, with $s_1,\ldots,s_d$ pairwise coprime.

symbols.name: axis index
symbols.meaning: A second index of an axis, running from 1 to d, used in the digit sums.
symbols.quote: Let $d$ be the number of axes, with $i$ and $j$ running from $1$ to $d$ as axis indices (not list positions), and let $s_i$ be the length of axis $i$, with $s_1,\ldots,s_d$ pairwise coprime.

relations.quote: Because $\Phi$ is an isomorphism, it preserves [Cyclic convolution](cyclic-convolution.md): products of lists map to products of images.
